title: Small stable influences without Fourier regularity
statement: For every natural number $n>0$ and every $\delta\in[0,1]$, there is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose stable influence at each coordinate, with noise parameter $1-\delta$, is at most $(1-\delta)^{n-1}$. Moreover, for every real $\varepsilon<1$, the function has a nonempty Fourier coefficient whose absolute value exceeds $\varepsilon$.
